name: Kluboslavija Pasoš
description: Tvoja putna isprava kroz GDG 2026. Svaka igra ostavlja pečat. 3 pečata čekaju te odmah — ostale zarađuješ jednu po jednu.

modules.src/main.js: Init, state machine orchestration, first-visit check
modules.src/config.js: Stamp registry (3 retro + format za buduće), reward thresholds
modules.src/ui.js: DOM rendering — passport pages, stamps, rewards, onboarding
modules.src/animations.js: CSS class toggles, timing, state machine transitions
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API — 5 sound events, lazy init na user gesture
modules.src/share.js: html2canvas screenshot, Web Share API, export/import JSON
modules.styles/ui.css: Passport korice, stranice, stamp krugovi, badges, rewards
modules.styles/game.css: Keyframe animacije: flipOpen, inkSpread, unlockGlow, onboarding
